# FCM-R4 real-block fixture provenance

These are value-preserving trimmed recompute surfaces from the local-only
`runs_window_a5_20260723` corpus. Source hashes and retained source ranges are
pinned in `measured_pair.json`; the source bundles were collected as strict-valid evidence. Their raw powermetrics
files were later pruned under the 2026-07-28 custody procedure, so the committed
fixture contains only the four D-124 read surfaces named by the oracle specification.
